purpose: Verify that the root vault remains readable, bounded, and auditable.

cases.check: root contains inbox, wiki, outputs, indexes, sources, dropped, state, domains, evals, system, rules, context, projects, logs, scripts, references, archives; retired memory, research, and processed roots are absent
every root directory is listed in indexes/folders.md or in the explicit ignored runtime set
each approved durable root folder has a README.md or is documented as a config/runtime exception
00-start-here.md links to the main indexes and v2 operating contract
every domains/*.md file has owner scope, exclusions, canonical sources, skills, agents, outputs, and open questions
every wiki page has an inbound link from 00-start-here.md, indexes, domains, or another wiki page
AGENTS.md and rules/memory-workflow.md state that durable generated artifacts go to root inbox before ingest
legacy Basic Memory imports are ingested out of inbox and archived outside the active memory spine
